1.name: Bros & Arrows
1.overview: Finn enters a crossbow tournament to prove his manliness, while Jake wrestles with telling him he's actually terrible at it.

1.name: Dandy Bug
1.overview: Finn is roped into a gentleman bug's duel and must master high-society pageantry before the big fight.

1.name: Cursed Words
1.overview: Finn discovers Jake burying bottled demon curses in the backyard and must convince him to finally dig them up.

1.name: Rescue Princess
1.overview: Finn and Jake must stop Ice King from himself as he pursues a delusional one-sided romance with the princess who rescued him.

1.name: Smell Detective
1.overview: Jake's new ghost-sensing power puts him in danger, and Finn must race to catch up before a ghost kid steals him away.

1.name: Golden Gals
1.overview: Finn and Jake are tasked with toughening up three sweet grannies for the fight of their lives against the fearsome Granny Taker.

1.name: Dummy Princess
1.overview: Ice King falls in love with a beautiful princess but little does he realize she is a dummy created by Finn and Jake to stop his nefarious ways.

1.name: Son of the Goblin Queen
1.overview: Finn and Jake are forced to help Ice King babysit the maniacal son of a Goblin Queen who Ice King claims to be dating.

1.name: All You Can Eat
1.overview: Jake enlists Finn's help to win a giant hot dog contest, but he's soon torn after discovering the win means doom for a family living in Jake's belly.

1.name: Let It Roll
1.overview: When Marceline saddles Finn and Jake with a clingy toilet paper creature, they must find it a new home before it destroys theirs.

1.name: Joey Waffles
1.overview: Finn and Jake inadvertently befriend a grass ogre who turns out to be the bane of their existence.

1.name: Island of Shame
1.overview: Following a big embarrassment, Finn flees society and lands on an island where he's taken in by a clan obsessed with their own shame.

1.name: The Candy Spirit
1.overview: After startling a mythical beast, Finn and Jake unleash Candy Ragnarök and must save the Kingdom from total ruin.

1.name: Game Night
1.overview: Sent by Princess Bubblegum, Finn and Jake venture into the Dream Realm to stop an evil spirit, who's been stealing all of the sweet dreams in the Candy Kingdom.

1.name: Punchy
1.overview: Finn and Jake stow away on PB's self-driving robot, PUNCHY. When PUNCHY gets confused by unforeseen obstacles, Finn suspects PUNCHY's gone traitor!

1.name: Key Quest
1.overview: Finn and Jake must help Ice King find his spare castle key after they accidentally teleport him into the treehouse while he is naked.

1.name: Love Bugs
1.overview: BMO tries to play matchmaker to two bugs but Finn and Jake crash the plan with their own ideas about romance, putting the budding love story at risk.

1.name: Re-Run Dungeon
1.overview: When Finn brings Jake to his favorite childhood dungeon and they're underwhelmed, Jake tries to make it as thrilling as Finn remembered.

1.name: The Prophecy
1.overview: Finn and Jake are duped into thinking they are long-prophesized gnome heroes in their first encounter with the "King of Ooo."

1.name: Car Wars
1.overview: Finn and Jake find a go-kart with no engine, so Jake becomes the engine, but his abilities are taken to the limit in a race with a taunting Marauder.

2.name: Death Fiction
2.overview: Finn and Jake's movie night goes off the rails.

2.name: Alpha Dog
2.overview: Finn disguises himself inside Jake's body.

2.name: The Chore Wheel
2.overview: Finn and Jake use a magical shortcut to avoid cleaning.

2.name: Tiny Negs
2.overview: Jake hires a bard to sing about Finn's heroics.

2.name: Freelancers
2.overview: Finn and Jake take a hero-for-hire job from a petty lord.

2.name: Sunshine Kingdom
2.overview: While vacationing at a fancy resort, Finn offers help.

2.name: Toad Wrestlers
2.overview: Jake's viola ends up in the hands of luchador toads.

2.name: Righteous Dude
2.overview: Finn and Jake follow a righteous hero into an epic battle before realizing that maybe all is not what it seems.

2.name: Head Hunted
2.overview: Jake fakes his own capture to help Ooo's worst hunter.

2.name: Text-Based Journey to Donut Palace
2.overview: A knife storm traps Finn and Jake indoors.

2.name: Wedgie Tree
2.overview: Finn confronts his mortality when he gets stuck in a tree.

2.name: The Notorious Pup Gang
2.overview: Three tough kids navigate the Candy Kingdom’s crime world to steal back a video game they took from Jake, trading it for cereal they can’t afford.

2.name: Storm Rider
2.overview: A mysterious cowgirl drifts into Ooo.

2.name: Curse of the Unread
2.overview: Finn is cursed by a magical book.

2.name: The Zipline
2.overview: Finn and Jake attempt to do the coolest thing.

2.name: Sweet Tooth
2.overview: Finn and Jake venture to the Dream Realm to defeat Mansion Feely, an evil spirit who’s been stealing all the sweet dreams from the Candy Kingdom.

2.name: Tiny Adventure Time
2.overview: Finn and Jake lead their friends on a wild backyard quest.

2.name: Escape from the Baby Kingdom
2.overview: Baby Finn sparks a diaper-clad uprising.

2.name: The Morrow Bird
2.overview: Finn and Jake must reclaim their treehouse from a colossal bird.

2.name: Ice Choir
2.overview: Finn and Jake join Ice King’s choir of Wintermas Day holiday carolers, but soon find they are being used for his nefarious gains.

overview: فین، قهرمان جوان، و جیک، بهترین دوست سگ جادویی‌اش، ماجراجویی‌هایی را در سرزمین خیالی اوو آغاز می‌کنند - با آدم‌های ابری مهمانی می‌گیرند و در طول مسیر با شر مبارزه می‌کنند.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The early days of Finn the Human and Jake the Dog as they embark on quests.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Finn and Jake are back for more adventure and even more side quests across the wild, wonderful land of Ooo. Wrestling toads, facing baby gladiators, and getting tangled up in one too many magic spells, it's clear no side quest is too strange, too small, or too dangerous to take on.

title: Adventure Time: Side Quests
